heading: Join the DC Social Collective Ambassador Team
intro: We're now accepting applications for 1 or 2 new female brand ambassadors to help grow DC's most vibrant young adult community. This isn't about clout, it's about connection, community, and showing up with style and substance.
intro2: If you're passionate about building community, love a good event with purpose, and know how to make people feel welcome, we want to hear from you.
list: You're the planner in your friend group
Your IG is public, aesthetic, and fun (and people actually watch your stories)
You love dressing up, going out, and hosting people
You know how to promote with meaning, not ego
You naturally make others feel seen and included
You live in or near DC or Northern Virginia and can attend events regularly
perks: Free access to all DSC events plus a plus-one
Early access to ticket links and announcements
A spotlight feature on our website (bio and photo)
A front-facing role in one of the region's most vibrant young adult communities
heroAlt: A DSC ambassador at the Strawberry Soiree
applyAlt: Four friends at a DSC ball
closedBody: We are not taking ambassador applications at the moment. Follow us on Instagram and we will announce the next round there.
